# Tumbite

> Tumbite is a food delivery app by Windoce LLC (Florida, United States). It connects customers, local restaurants, and drivers: restaurants pay a 7.5% to 15% commission depending on their plan, with no lock-in contracts; drivers keep 100% of the tip and see what they earn before accepting; customers see the full breakdown before paying and follow their order live. Every paid order is watched by an automatic Manager that reminds the restaurant and refunds the customer if nobody confirms within 10 minutes. It starts in Miami and opens city by city, in any country, with local franchises that fund the launch (a fleet of motorbikes, training, a tablet for every restaurant, and finding the first customers). The app is bilingual (English and Spanish). Contact: support@tumbite.com · franchises: sales@tumbite.com.

## Guides (Docs)

- [Docs · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs): Short guides for ordering, for restaurants, and for drivers.
- [Ordering · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering): ⌘K← Docs OrderingHow to place your first orderPick a nearby restaurant, build your cart, and pay with a card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.Track your order liv
- [How to place your first order · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/first-order): Pick a nearby restaurant, build your cart, and pay with a card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.
- [Track your order live · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/track-order): Confirmed, in the kitchen, on the way, and delivered, with your driver on the map.
- [Cancel an order and get your money back · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/cancel-order): Until the restaurant accepts it, you cancel in one tap and get a full refund. And if the restaurant doesn’t answer, we cancel it for you.
- [My account: your orders, cards, and details · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/my-account): All your orders and their status, the cards you saved, and your details, in one place in the app.
- [Gifts: birthday, punch card, and win-back · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/rewards): Restaurants reward you for coming back. Gifts show up in your cart on their own.
- [Rate the food and the driver · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/ordering/rate): Two separate ratings. If the food was late, it’s not the driver’s fault.
- [For restaurants · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants): ⌘K← Docs For restaurantsPut your restaurant on TumbiteCreate your account, complete your profile, and wait for approval. No lock-in contracts.Your menu: it
- [Put your restaurant on Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/get-started): Create your account, complete your profile, and wait for approval. No lock-in contracts.
- [Your menu: items, prices, and photos · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/menu): Every item in English and Spanish, with its price, category, and photo.
- [Mark an item as sold out · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/sold-out): Out of chicken? Turn it off for today in one tap and nobody can order it.
- [Receiving orders and the alarm · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/orders): It rings loud until someone accepts. No order gets forgotten at rush hour.
- [Your dashboard: how your restaurant is doing · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/dashboard): Orders, sales, your payout, best sellers, your real kitchen time, and what customers think, at a glance.
- [Verify your restaurant · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/verify): Four photos from your phone: your ID, your face, and your storefront. That’s how your customers know you’re real.
- [Gifts and marketing · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/gifts): Set aside a share of your sales to reward loyal customers.
- [Daily summary and your wallet · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/restaurants/earnings): Orders, sales, commission, and your payout. Cash out to your bank.
- [For drivers · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers): ⌘K← Docs For driversStart deliveringCreate your account, go online when you want, and accept only what works for you.Verify your identityYour ID and a phot
- [Start delivering · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/get-started): Create your account, go online when you want, and accept only what works for you.
- [Verify your identity · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/verify): Your ID and a photo of your face, right from the app. It’s what gives customers peace of mind when they open the door.
- [Offers: see what you earn before you accept · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/offers): You see the pay, the distance, and the pickup spot. Declining never counts against you.
- [Levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/levels): Higher levels see bigger orders first. You level up with deliveries and good ratings.
- [Your wallet: what you earn and how you cash out · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/drivers/wallet): Like a banking app: your balance, earnings, tips, and every movement with its order. Cash out to your bank whenever you want.
- [How we look after every order · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust): ⌘K← Docs How we look after every orderThe Manager: no order gets forgottenAn automatic watcher follows every order from payment to the door, and steps in o
- [The Manager: no order gets forgotten · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/manager): An automatic watcher follows every order from payment to the door, and steps in only when something runs late.
- [The traffic light on every order · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/traffic-light): Green, yellow, or red: at a glance you know which order is fine and which one needs attention.
- [Verified restaurants and drivers · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/trust/verification): Every restaurant is a real business and every driver is who they say they are. A person on our team checks it.
- [For entrepreneurs · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/business): ⌘K← Docs For entrepreneursFranchises: bring Tumbite to your cityEvery new city opens with a local partner. What you pay for isn’t a brand: it’s a complete 
- [Franchises: bring Tumbite to your city](https://tumbite.com/docs/business/franchises): Every new city opens with a local partner. What you pay for isn’t a brand: it’s a complete launch, with a fleet, training, tablets, and the first customers
- [Your account · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account): ⌘K← Docs Your accountForgot my passwordWe email you a link. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.Confirm your emailWhen you sign up, you get a link to c
- [Forgot my password · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/password): We email you a link. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
- [Confirm your email · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/confirm-email): When you sign up, you get a link to confirm the email is yours.
- [Delete your account · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/delete): From the account menu, in the three dots. Your personal data is removed.
- [Help from a real person, with your own link · Tumbite](https://tumbite.com/docs/account/support): Report a problem from the app or write to us: every case gets its own private conversation, and we email you every time we reply.
